title: Use-case-driven ontology modeling with the NeOn methodology for ambient assisted living
abstract: arXiv:2611.17466v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Research on smart homes and ambient assisted living (AAL) has grown steadily over the last decade, driven largely by the ageing of the population. A smart home has to coordinate heterogeneous smart objects in order to offer services tailored to its dwellers, and this requires a shared formal description of both the dwellers and the devices. We present the ontology developed as the semantic data layer of the Virtual Home Framework in the Italian Design For All project. Its requirements are derived from two use cases: a frail elderly woman who exercises at home on a cycle-ergometer, and a designer who configures a kitchen for users with different impairments. The requirements are collected in an Ontology Requirements Specification Document and the ontology is built with the NeOn methodology, reusing and reengineering existing ontologies where possible. translated_title: 基于用例驱动与NeOn方法学的环境辅助生活本体建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.17466v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在过去十年中，智能家居与环境辅助生活（AAL）的研究稳步增长，其主要驱动力是人口老龄化。智能家居需要协调异构的智能对象，以便为住户提供量身定制的服务，这就需要对住户和设备进行共享的形式化描述。我们介绍了在意大利“为所有人设计”（Design For All）项目中作为虚拟家庭框架语义数据层而开发的本体。其需求来源于两个用例：一位在家中骑功率自行车锻炼的体弱老年女性，以及一位为具有不同障碍的用户配置厨房的设计师。这些需求被收集在《本体需求规格说明文档》中，本体则采用NeOn方法学构建，并在可能的情况下复用和再工程现有本体。所得的模块化本体通过国际分类……（原文在此处截断）描述用户。
tldr: 该论文面向环境辅助生活场景，基于两个真实用例收集需求、采用NeOn方法学并复用再工程现有本体，为意大利Design For All项目的虚拟家庭框架构建了模块化本体作为语义数据层。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a modular, use-case-driven ontology for ambient assisted living using the NeOn methodology with reuse of existing ontologies, serving as the semantic data layer of the Virtual Home Framework in the Italian Design For All project.
